implementation_boundary.owned_wrapper: The Process instance's direct subprocess.Popen in self._proc; no unrelated process is targeted.
implementation_boundary.descendants: On startup failure, force_kill_process_tree_until snapshots current descendants of the owned wrapper and terminates captured descendants before the wrapper; cleanup result reports wrapper reap and observed live descendants. No process-group-wide claim is made.
implementation_boundary.deadline: 20 seconds total for failure cleanup; process-tree operation is given all but the final 2 seconds, which are reserved for joining registered stdout/stderr readers.
implementation_boundary.error_behavior: The original startup exception is re-raised. Cleanup failures or incomplete cleanup are attached as exception notes; cleanup exceptions do not replace the startup failure.
